info.title: VeruSuite APIs
info.summary: Mail, calendar and workspace administration for a VeruSuite workspace.
info.description:
Every call is authorised by a key you create yourself and acts as you, limited to the permissions you granted it. Keys are issued at veruapis.com.

This document is generated from the same tables that route and gate the API, so it cannot describe an endpoint the server does not serve.

post.description:
Creates an event and sends invitations to any attendees.

Listing an attendee sends them an invitation. To reschedule afterwards use PATCH rather than deleting and recreating: PATCH keeps the id and UID and raises the sequence, so their calendar updates the meeting in place instead of cancelling one and inviting them to another.

get.description:
Lists events across every calendar in a time range, with recurring events expanded. Start and end are required: a recurring series has no finite end.

start and end are required because a recurring series expands without limit — there is no finite answer to "all events". Recurring events arrive already expanded, one entry per occurrence. Times are UTC; the offset a calendar app shows is that app's timezone, so anything scheduling by wall-clock time needs the user's zone from elsewhere.

Sends mail from the workspace user the key acts as. Requires mail.send, which is deliberately separate from mail.messages.write.
